_comment: Pinned third-party downloads used by the packaging scripts. The Node.js entry is only used to run the scripts inside WSL (node tools/package/downloads.mjs update-node <version> pins another one; its SHA-256 comes from https://nodejs.org/dist/v<version>/SHASUMS256.txt and is checked on every use). For the AppImage tools, copy the digest GitHub shows for the release asset and check it after downloading.
